messages:
jordan_sales: Hey team — Acme Legal just asked for our SOC 2 report + a signed NDA before we start the POC. They also requested a short security attestation/bridge letter about data handling and retention. They want something by EOD Tue. Can we provide a redacted SOC 2 extract and a temporary attestation? @tanya_security @lisa_legal

tanya_security: We can produce a redacted SOC 2 extract (control summaries + the assertion letter) and a bridge-letter style attestation. Redaction needs legal sign-off. Also FYI we typically only send full reports under an executed DPA / enterprise contract.

lisa_legal: If it's their NDA, we'll need ~3 business days to review. If they sign our mutual NDA (standard mutual), we can countersign same day. Please ask them to sign our template. Also bridge letters must include the usual disclaimer that it's not a substitute for the SOC 2 report.

diego_solutions: For the POC we can offer scoped S3 access + ephemeral creds. Ops can spin up creds for 7 days and we can provide an architecture diagram and data flow doc. That should cover their immediate risk review while the NDA/SOC2 items are processed. Bucket: `acme-poc-bucket`

jordan_sales: Got it. I'll push them to sign our mutual NDA. If they insist on their form, I'll flag 3 business days. Can we rush a redacted extract (no control owner names, no IP)?

tanya_security: Yes. I'll prepare a redacted extract (no PII, no vendor-specific IP). Give me ~4 hours to pull the assertion, control descriptions, and mapping summary. I'll also draft a short attestation that scope = Redwood hosted API (no on-prem components). Need confirmation on retention policy to include in the attestation.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: temporary_creds created for `acme-poc-bucket` - expires in 7 days (1769451234). Credentials delivered to diego_solutions via secure channel.

lisa_legal: Jordan — please ask them to accept our mutual NDA link: https://redwood.intra/nda/mutual. If they return their NDA, upload it to the legal queue and tag me. Also confirm signatory name and company entity.

diego_solutions: Also note: if the POC requires dedicated capacity or larger token volumes, pricing will change — let's capture that in the POC statement of work. Jordan, can you clarify expected qps and dataset sizes?

jordan_sales: Will ask. One more Q: once they sign our NDA, can Tanya upload the redacted SOC2 to a secure share and I send the link immediately?

tanya_security: Yes — once NDA is executed we can upload to Box with restricted access. I'll generate a single redacted PDF and a short control mapping sheet (csv). I'll mark any residual sensitive items as [REDACTED].

jordan_sales: Sweet. Pushed them to sign now.

(4 hours later)

jordan_sales: Update — Acme signed our mutual NDA at 16:40. They sent a confirmation PDF as well. @lisa_legal do we need to countersign?

lisa_legal: I see the executed version in the legal queue. Countersigned and uploaded at 16:53. Jordan you can share the Box link once Tanya confirms upload.

tanya_security: Uploaded redacted SOC2 extract + control summary to Box: https://redwood.box/s/acme-soc2-redacted (access restricted to acme@acme.com; link expires in 30 days). Bridge-letter draft also uploaded: `acme_bridge_attestation_v1.pdf`. Note bridge content: scope = Redwood Hosted API only; retention = 30 days default; encryption at rest + in transit; no shared model weights.

diego_solutions: Temp creds still valid and delivered to acme POC contact via secure channel. Confirmed access to `acme-poc-bucket` and sample data ingestion works (tested `aws s3 ls s3://acme-poc-bucket`).

jordan_sales: Perfect — thanks all :raised_hands: I'll send the Box link to the customer and attach the bridge-letter. Also will log the POC pricing caveat about dedicated capacity. Follow-up: Acme asked about SOC 2 scope dates (period covered). Tanya, can you add the period covered to the file metadata?

tanya_security: Done — SOC2 period = 2024-07-01 to 2025-06-30 included in the extract header. Also added the standard boilerplate: 'This extract is provided subject to executed NDA and is redacted to protect third-party information. It is not a replacement for a full report.'

jordan_sales: Great. Customer replied: 'Thanks — this works for now. We'll proceed with the POC. Can you also provide a contact for security/technical follow-ups?' I'll forward them Diego and Tanya.

diego_solutions: I'll take the tech calls; Tanya will handle security questionnaire follow-ups (SIG/CAIQ mapping).

jordan_sales: Closing the loop here. Acme confirmed POC kickoff Wed morning. Thanks everyone.
